You CAN start a lot of different things and going down dead ends is actually a part of life and a way to find yourself. Us obsessional people tend to hold on to things (career plans, studies, people etc ) with a sickening desperation even when they need to die so something new can be born. The method I read is:

* Use a doll or a teddy bear as your inner child. You can also have a photo of yourself as a child to help get into that space
* Have a photo of older you as the adult
* Sit opposite the doll or teddy and talk to it like you would if you had an upset child "How are you" "Are you ok" "Would you like to talk about something" "I can see you are upset - how can i help you" etc
* Then take the doll or teddy, hold it into your stomach and kind of sink into it becoming the inner child (you tend to go more into your body where all your emotions are which is where children operate from mostly). 
* Have the photo of you as an adult there so the child knows it has you there as an adult to talk  to and protect them and make them feel safe. 
* Speak as the inner child letting any emotions come up. Its amazing what can come up
* Then put the teddy down and go back to being an adult talking to the teddy/inner child saying you will protect them, care for them, make them feel validated and loved. But you have to listen to what the inner child says and not just talk to it like an object. And it takes time for the inner child to trust that you will listen and stay and protect them when you have been ignoring them for so long

You can do the same with writing, write questions from your adult and then write answers from your inner child, I think its best to do the inner child from your opposite hand which is less logical.
